title: Fourier coefficient of the mod-two inner-product function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $S$ be any subset of the $2n$ coordinates. The absolute value of the Fourier coefficient indexed by $S$ of the Boolean function obtained by encoding the mod-two inner product of the two $n$-bit blocks as a sign is $2^{-n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $2n$ coordinates
